categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in urban transport planning and design, engineering design and testing, big data software services, intelligent traffic system integration and operation, engineering construction, and engineering testing. It focuses on digital consulting, smart transportation products, new infrastructure projects, and commercial operations, especially in emerging sectors like low-altitude economy, intelligent connected vehicles, and energy-transport integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including digital twin (CIM), AI-driven traffic big models, embodied intelligence, edge-cloud collaborative computing, and multi-source data fusion. It develops integrated hardware and software solutions such as intelligent traffic signal controllers, low-altitude integrated communication devices, virtual power plants, and large-scale virtual-real training platforms. The company emphasizes R&D in AI, digital infrastructure, and smart hardware with continuous investment exceeding 10% of revenue.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments and large state-owned enterprises, primarily in urban transport and infrastructure sectors. The company serves over 160 major cities across China and has expanded internationally to countries along the Belt and Road, including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Kazakhstan. Its markets include urban transport planning, smart city infrastructure, low-altitude economy, intelligent connected vehicles, and energy-transport integration hubs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, with operations covering 30 provinces and over 160 cities in China. It has established subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese cities and international presence in Hong Kong, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Kazakhstan. It leads projects in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and actively pursues global expansion in Belt and Road countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the urban transport and smart infrastructure supply chain. It provides planning, design, software development, hardware integration, construction, operation, and maintenance services. It also engages in commercial operation of infrastructure assets and smart transport services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider from consulting to product delivery and operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically focused on digitalization, intelligentization, and productization, the company invests heavily in R&D for AI-driven traffic models, digital twin platforms, edge-cloud computing, and smart hardware. It leads national key R&D projects and develops standards in low-altitude economy, intelligent connected vehicles, and energy-transport integration. The company aims to build a new generation autonomous urban transport system with integrated software-hardware solutions and expand commercial operations domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through professional technical services including urban transport planning, engineering design and testing, and big data software and smart traffic solutions. The company also earns from hardware product sales, system integration, engineering construction, and operation and maintenance services. It operates on a direct sales model with contracts primarily from government and large enterprises, supplemented by commercial operation of infrastructure assets and smart transport services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading urban transport planning and smart infrastructure technology provider in China, recognized as a core technical support unit for Shenzhen's low-altitude economy and intelligent connected vehicle initiatives. It holds a dominant position in new infrastructure sectors like low-altitude integrated systems and smart transport digital platforms. It competes with other national and regional urban transport and smart city technology firms, leveraging strong government backing, extensive R&D, and comprehensive service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.316 billion, a 7.26% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 105.7 million, down 34.74%. Despite revenue decline in traditional planning and design, new business segments like big data software and smart traffic grew by over 27%. Total assets reached RMB 3.52 billion, up 8.87%, with a healthy asset-liability ratio of 30.28%. The company maintains strong cash reserves and continues to invest over 11% of revenue in R&D, supporting stable operations and future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'software-hardware-operation' model, combining advanced AI, digital twin technology, and embodied intelligence to deliver comprehensive urban transport solutions. It offers standardized, scalable products and platforms like the TransPaaS smart traffic system and low-altitude integrated infrastructure, supported by extensive R&D and national key projects. Its strong government partnerships, industry-leading standards development, and international expansion provide unique competitive advantages in emerging smart city and transport sectors.
